Two cultures that have both been regarded as the sweetest, most artistic cultures of their geographies - why is it that we see a resemblance between them? In this video, we explore the parallels between French and Bengali culture in the context of the histories of Europe and India and do a deep dive into an interconnected tapestry of linguistics, history, geography, and absurdism!
Special thank you to Pratyush Roy Dasgupta, Neline Mondal, Arka Patra, Arshal.
